references.text: The Lord will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you shall serve other gods—the same theme about gods from the ends of the earth.
Warning against worshipping the host of heaven as other nations do—a parallel warning against foreign gods.
You shall not follow other gods, any of the gods of the peoples around you—a direct parallel concerning the gods of the surrounding nations.
Beware lest you be enticed to follow them and inquire after their gods—a warning against following the gods of neighboring peoples.
Turn to me from all the ends of the earth—using the same expression regarding the ends of the earth.
Those slain by the Lord on that day shall lie from one end of the earth to the other—the same geographical expression.
